items.source: Adds this additional metadata to the all built Documents.
items.translation: 向所有构建的Document添加此附加元数据。

items.source: Text divided by horizontal lines will create new Documents. The default is false, meaning text separated by horizontal lines won't create a new document.
items.translation: 通过水平线分隔的文本将创建新的Document。默认值为false，这意味着由水平线分隔的文本不会创建新文档。

items.source: Whatever to include code blocks in Documents. The default is false, which means all code blocks are in separate documents.
items.translation: 无论是否要在Document中包含代码块。默认值为false，这意味着所有代码块都位于独立的文档中。

items.source: Whatever to include blockquotes in Documents. The default is false, which means all blockquotes are in separate documents.
items.translation: 无论是否要在Document中包含引用块。默认值为false，这意味着所有引用块都位于独立的文档中。

items.source: Text divided by horizontal lines will create new Documents.
items.translation: 通过水平线分隔的内容将创建新的Document。

items.source: Whatever to include blockquotes in Documents.
items.translation: 无论是否要在Document中包含引用块。

items.source: Whatever to include code blocks in Documents.
items.translation: 无论是否要在Document中包含代码块。

items.source: horizontalRuleCreateDocument - flag to determine whether new documents are created from text divided by horizontal line
items.translation: horizontalRuleCreateDocument - 标志，用于确定是否从由水平线分隔的文本中创建新文档

items.source: includeCodeBlock - flag to include code block into paragraph document or create new with code only
items.translation: includeCodeBlock - 标志，用于将代码块包含在段落文档中，或创建仅含代码的新文档。

items.source: includeBlockquote - flag to include blockquotes into paragraph document or create new with blockquote only
items.translation: includeBlockquote - 标志，用于将块引用包含在段落文档中，或创建仅包含块引用的新文档。
